title: Synthesis, Characterization, and Comprehensive In Vitro and In Silico Evaluation of the Anti-Inflammatory Potential of Novel 1,2,3-Triazole-Arylidenehydrazide/Thiazolidinone Hybrids.
authors: Pepe, Nihan Aktas; Cakir, Furkan; Atalay, Tugba; Acar, Busra; Turgut, Gurbet Celik; Sen, Alaattin; Senol, Halil
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新型三唑杂环化合物的抗炎活性，分子对接与MD针对TNF-alpha/iNOS蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: Five novel 1,2,3-triazole/arylidenehydrazide/thiazolidinone hybrid compounds (7-11) were synthesized and characterized using NMR, HRMS, IR, and HPLC purity analysis. The cytotoxicity of these compounds was evaluated on fibroblasts and THP-1 cells, showing that all compounds were nontoxic at the tested concentrations. The wound healing assay revealed that compounds 7, 9, and 10 significantly enhanced wound closure, with a 7.74%-32.69% improvement in treated cells. Compounds 8 and 11 showed moderate effects. Anti-inflammatory activity was assessed through qRT-PCR, demonstrating that compound 10 led to the most significant reduction in proinflammatory cytokines TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and NF-kappaB1. In addition, the expression of Iba1 protein in THP-1 cells confirmed that compound 8 showed the strongest anti-inflammatory effect, surpassing that of aspirin. Compound 10 showed the highest inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling and iNOS activity. Molecular docking studies revealed that compounds 10 and 11 had strong binding affinities to TNF-alpha and iNOS, with compound 11 showing the most stable interactions. Molecular dynamics simulations supported these findings, indicating that compound 11 demonstrated more stable binding to both targets. Overall, the results suggest that compounds 10 and 11 are promising anti-inflammatory candidates with potential for further development in therapeutic applications for inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 合成了五种新型1,2,3-三唑/亚芳基肼/噻唑烷酮杂合化合物（7-11），并通过NMR、HRMS、IR及HPLC纯度分析进行了表征。评估了这些化合物对成纤维细胞和THP-1细胞的细胞毒性，结果显示所有化合物在测试浓度下均无毒性。伤口愈合实验表明，化合物7、9和10显著增强了伤口闭合，处理细胞中的改善幅度为7.74%-32.69%。化合物8和11表现出中等效果。通过qRT-PCR评估抗炎活性，显示化合物10对促炎细胞因子TNF-α、IL-1β和NF-κB1的降低作用最为显著。此外，THP-1细胞中Iba1蛋白的表达证实，化合物8表现出最强的抗炎效果，超过了阿司匹林。化合物10对NF-κB信号通路和iNOS活性的抑制作用最高。分子对接研究揭示，化合物10和11与TNF-α和iNOS具有强结合亲和力，其中化合物11显示出最稳定的相互作用。分子动力学模拟支持这些发现，表明化合物11对两个靶点的结合更为稳定。总体而言，结果表明化合物10和11是有前景的抗炎候选药物，具有在炎症性疾病治疗应用中进一步开发的潜力。
